column1: # Amharic abbreviation table for the expand_abbreviations step. Writing abbreviates and
# speech does not. An abbreviation on either side is rewritten to its spoken form.
# written  a regex over the written forms of one abbreviation, with . and / as separators.
#          It matches inside word boundaries. A one-letter prefix may attach, and a suffix's
#          vowel change carries onto the expansion, so ት/ቤቱ becomes ትምህርት ቤቱ.
# spoken   the expansion, spelled as edited Ethiopian news text spells it.
# note     what the pattern covers, and why the expansion is spelled so.

column3: Ethiopian era marker. Covers ዓ.ም ዓ.ም. ዓ/ም ዓም ዓም. and the separated ዐ-initial writings (ዐ.ም, ዐ/ም), with spaces around the separator (ዓ. ም.). A bare space with no separator is not a marker, and the dotless ዐም is left alone: it is rare in writing and ዐ folds to አ, which would make አም a marker. The spelling ምህረት is the majority in edited Ethiopian news text and in written Amharic at large; ምሕረት is the minority and folds to it under WER-N.
Era marker for years before the Incarnation (ዓ.ዓ, ዓ/ዓ).

Gregorian era marker. Covers እ.ኤ.አ እ.ኤ.አ. እ.አ.አ እ/ኤ/አ, the dotless እኤአ and እአአ, partly dotted እ.ኤአ, and the ኢ- and ኣ-letter variants, all attested in written Amharic. The expansion spells ኤውሮፓውያን, after the abbreviation's own second letter. ኤ and አ do not fold under WER-N, so the two spellings never meet and the choice decides the score.
Kilometre; the trailing dot is the abbreviation's, not the sentence's.
Assistant professor; ረ/ፕ alone is ambiguous with ፕሬዚዳንት and is not expanded.
Deputy; the suffix carry gives ም/ሉ → ምክትሉ.
Lieutenant general; the frozen sets write ሌ/ጄነራል.
Prime minister; ጠ/ሚ without the ር is ambiguous between the person and the ministry and is not expanded. ሚ/ር (ሚኒስትር or ሚስተር) and አ.አ (አዲስ አበባ or initials) are likewise left alone.
Ambiguous between the prime minister and the ministry. Kept as one word.
Ambiguous between ሚኒስትር and ሚስተር. Kept as one word.
Ambiguous between አዲስ አበባ and initials. Kept as one word, so it is not read as two fillers.
Ambiguous between ረዳት ፕሮፌሰር and ፕሬዚዳንት. Kept as one word.
